description: collections_search — FamilySearch record collections at Pennsylvania STATE scope, for the call shape where the skill has already resolved a county to its state (standardPlace 'Pennsylvania, United States') rather than passing the county. Companion to collections-search-schuylkill, whose '~Schuylkill' predicate cannot match a state-level standardPlace; declare this one AFTER it so the county-specific fixture still wins for county calls. Added because the unmatched state-level call was scoring Correctness and Tool Arguments to 1 on ut_search_external_sites_001 (observed in run logs v1_2026-09-17_04-58-35 and v1_2026-09-22_07-05-19), failing the test on a fixture gap rather than on anything the skill did wrong.
